versions.name: RXV2-0.9.245-field-ble
versions.notes: Field mode is now Bluetooth-only (no more auto AP when home WiFi is absent; AP still available in WiFi settings). Update page explains the Bluetooth app path instead of claiming updates are impossible. Current-flight view no longer shows the TX switch-off as a scary longest gap. Flight graph: missing sensors greyed out, battery noise no longer magnified. Aileron wave now repeats on every landing of a session.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.244-plane-blackbox
versions.notes: Blackbox now works on planes (no flight controller needed): flights record and save using the receiver's own battery divider. Adds radio swap count and per-transceiver time to flight stats. Includes the shutdown-gap trim and BLE aileron wave from 0.9.243.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.243-tidy-gaps-wave
versions.notes: Blackbox: TX switch-off no longer records a misleading final gap in saved flights. New: after the TX goes off, the receiver waves the ailerons when Bluetooth/WiFi become available.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.237-bind-safe
versions.notes: SAFETY: the propeller could blip during a reboot-into-bind (prop fitted, hands near the model). Two defences: (1) every web-initiated reboot now pushes ~100ms of throttle-low frames and parks the output pin idle-high through the restart, so the converter/FC sees silence instead of noise; (2) the throttle stays pinned low until the link has delivered a stable stream (25 channel packets ≈ 0.5s) — covering the no-TX boot AND the first moments after binding, when a V1 transmitter in bind mode bypasses its own motor-low overrides.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.236-install-clarity
versions.notes: Two update-flow niceties from Malcolm's hunting-lodge session: (1) trying to install while the receiver isn't on home WiFi now gets a plain explanation (the RECEIVER downloads the image itself, so the phone's internet can't help) instead of a cryptic failure; (2) an elapsed-time ticker during installs — the chip can't report true progress while flashing, but an honest count beats a frozen screen.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.235-tx-failsafe
versions.notes: The transmitter's 'send failsafe to receiver' button now works on RXV2 (it was silently ignored): it captures the current channel positions — trims and subtrims included, since they're baked into the radio stream — exactly like the web 'Save failsafe' button. And with the FC-telemetry switch OFF (no flight controller, e.g. a PWM converter), the receiver now STREAMS the captured failsafe posture on CRSF after signal loss instead of going silent and letting the converter drift.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.234-civilised-ota
versions.notes: Civilised OTA (Malcolm's word): when the connection drops during an install — routine over Bluetooth, and at the reboot moment on WiFi — the page no longer cries 'failed'. It says 'Installing… waiting for the receiver to come back', polls until the receiver reappears, and judges by the version it reports: new version = success (auto-reload), same old version = a real failure, still absent after 5 min = 'reload in a moment'.
